sloka: सृष्टः क्रोधाभिभूतेन विनाशार्थं दुरात्मनोः ।मधुकैटभयोर्वीर विघाते वर्तमानयोः ।स्रष्टुकामेन लोकांस्त्रींस्तौ चानेन हतौ युधि ।। ७.६३.२२ ॥
transliteration: sṛṣṭaḥ krodhābhibhūtena vināśārthaṁ durātmanoḥ ।madhukaiṭabhayorvīra vighāte vartamānayoḥ ।sraṣṭukāmena lokāṁstrīṁstau cānena hatau yudhi ।। 7.63.22 ॥

translations.english: O hero, this arrow was created by the angry (Vishnu) for the destruction of the two wicked demons, Madhu and Kaitabha, who were obstructing the creation of the three worlds, and indeed, those two were killed in battle by this very arrow.
